64	        private fun drawPowerChart(history: List<HistoryPoint>): Bitmap {
65	            val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(CHART_WIDTH, CHART_HEIGHT, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
66	            val canvas = Canvas(bitmap)
67	
68	            // 背景
69	            canvas.drawColor(0xFF1A1A20.toInt())
70	
71	            if (history.isEmpty()) {
72	                // 无数据时显示提示
73	                val paint = Paint().apply {
74	                    color = 0xFF666666.toInt()
75	                    textSize = 24f
76	                    textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
77	                    isAntiAlias = true
78	                }
79	                canvas.drawText("暂无数据", CHART_WIDTH / 2f, CHART_HEIGHT / 2f + 8f, paint)
80	                return bitmap
81	            }
82	
83	            // 获取最近的数据点（最多显示30个点）
84	            val recentPoints = history.takeLast(30)
85	            if (recentPoints.size < 2) {
86	                val paint = Paint().apply {
87	                    color = 0xFF666666.toInt()
88	                    textSize = 24f
89	                    textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
90	                    isAntiAlias = true
91	                }
92	                canvas.drawText("数据不足", CHART_WIDTH / 2f, CHART_HEIGHT / 2f + 8f, paint)
93	                return bitmap
94	            }
95	
96	            val powers = recentPoints.map { it.powerW.toFloat() }
97	            val maxPower = powers.maxOrNull() ?: 50f
98	            val minPower = 0f
99	            val powerRange = (maxPower - minPower).coerceAtLeast(1f)
100	
101	            val padding = 20f
102	            val chartWidth = CHART_WIDTH - padding * 2
103	            val chartHeight = CHART_HEIGHT - padding * 2
104	
105	            // 绘制网格线
106	            val gridPaint = Paint().apply {
107	                color = 0xFF2A2A32.toInt()
108	                strokeWidth = 1f
109	                style = Paint.Style.STROKE
110	            }
111	            for (i in 0..4) {
112	                val y = padding + chartHeight * i / 4
113	                canvas.drawLine(padding, y, CHART_WIDTH - padding, y, gridPaint)
114	            }
115	
116	            // 绘制功率曲线
117	            val linePaint = Paint().apply {
118	                color = 0xFF7C9DFF.toInt()
119	                strokeWidth = 3f
120	                style = Paint.Style.STROKE
121	                isAntiAlias = true
122	                strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
123	                strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
124	            }
125	
126	            val fillPaint = Paint().apply {
127	                color = 0x307C9DFF.toInt()
128	                style = Paint.Style.FILL
129	                isAntiAlias = true
130	            }
131	
132	            val path = Path()
133	            val fillPath = Path()
134	            val stepX = chartWidth / (recentPoints.size - 1)
135	
136	            // 计算第一个点的位置
137	            val firstX = padding
138	            val firstY = padding + chartHeight * (1 - (powers[0] - minPower) / powerRange)
139	            path.moveTo(firstX, firstY)
140	            fillPath.moveTo(firstX, CHART_HEIGHT - padding)
141	            fillPath.lineTo(firstX, firstY)
142	
143	            // 绘制曲线
144	            for (i in 1 until powers.size) {
145	                val x = padding + stepX * i
146	                val y = padding + chartHeight * (1 - (powers[i] - minPower) / powerRange)
147	                path.lineTo(x, y)
148	                fillPath.lineTo(x, y)
149	            }
150	
151	            // 完成填充路径
152	            fillPath.lineTo(padding + stepX * (powers.size - 1), CHART_HEIGHT - padding)
153	            fillPath.close()
154	
155	            // 绘制填充区域和曲线
156	            canvas.drawPath(fillPath, fillPaint)
157	            canvas.drawPath(path, linePaint)
158	
159	            // 绘制当前值点
160	            val lastX = padding + stepX * (powers.size - 1)
161	            val lastY = padding + chartHeight * (1 - (powers.last() - minPower) / powerRange)
162	            val dotPaint = Paint().apply {
163	                color = 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt()
164	                style = Paint.Style.FILL
165	                isAntiAlias = true
166	            }
167	            canvas.drawCircle(lastX, lastY, 5f, dotPaint)
168

171	                color = 0xFF999999.toInt()
172	                textSize = 16f
173	                textAlign = Paint.Align.LEFT
174	                isAntiAlias = true
175	            }
176	            canvas.drawText("${String.format("%.0f", maxPower)}W", padding, padding - 5f, maxLabelPaint)
177	
178	            return bitmap

6	
7	/**
8	 * 从模块 HTML 中解析模式描述，实现 App 与 WebUI 自动同步
9	 * HTML 中模式按钮格式：
10	 *   <button class="mode-btn" data-mode="balance" onclick="setMode('balance')">
11	 *     均衡 <small>目标46°C自学习+电量保护</small>
12	 *   </button>
13	 */
14	object ModuleHtmlParser {
15	
16	    // 缓存解析结果，避免每次都读文件
17	    private var cachedDescs: Map<String, String>? = null
18	    private var lastHtmlContent: String? = null
19	
20	    /**
21	     * 从模块 HTML 中读取模式描述，解析失败时返回 ChargeMode 的硬编码 desc 作为 fallback
22	     */
23	    suspend fun getModeDescriptions(): Map<String, String> {
24	        try {
25	            val html = ShellExecutor.readFile(ModuleConfig.INDEX_HTML)
26	                ?: return fallbackDescs()
27	
28	            // 只有 HTML 内容变化时才重新解析
29	            if (html != lastHtmlContent) {
30	                lastHtmlContent = html
31	                cachedDescs = parseModeDescriptions(html)
32	            }
33	            return cachedDescs ?: fallbackDescs()
34	        } catch (_: Exception) {
35	            return fallbackDescs()
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    /**
40	     * 从 HTML 中提取模式按钮的 label 和 desc
41	     */
42	    private fun parseModeDescriptions(html: String): Map<String, String> {
43	        val descs = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
44	
45	        // 匹配模式按钮块：<button class="mode-btn" data-mode="xxx" onclick="...">
46	        //   Label <small>Description</small>
47	        // </button>
48	        val buttonRegex = Regex(
49	            """<button\s+class="mode-btn"\s+data-mode="(\w+)".*?>\s*(.+?)\s*</button>""",
50	            setOf(RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
51	        )
52	
53	        for (match in buttonRegex.findAll(html)) {
54	            val mode = match.groupValues[1]
55	            val content = match.groupValues[2].trim()
56	
57	            // 提取 label（<small> 之前的文字）和 desc（<small> 中的文字）
58	            val smallRegex = Regex("""(.+?)\s*<small>(.+?)</small>""", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
59	            val smallMatch = smallRegex.find(content)
60	            if (smallMatch != null) {
61	                val label = smallMatch.groupValues[1].trim()
62	                val desc = smallMatch.groupValues[2].trim()
63	                descs[mode] = desc
64	            }
65	        }
66	
67	        return descs.ifEmpty { fallbackDescs() }
68	    }
69	
70	    /**
71	     * fallback：使用 ChargeMode 中的硬编码描述
72	     */
73	    private fun fallbackDescs(): Map<String, String> {
74	        return ChargeMode.entries.associate { it.key to it.desc }
75	    }
76	}

        typography = Typography(),
        content = content
    )

```kotlin
data class ChargeStatus(
    val charging: Boolean = false,    // 关键: 是否正在充电
    val mode: ChargeMode = ChargeMode.BALANCE,
    val soc: Int = 0,                 // 电量百分比
    val temp: Int = 0,                // 温度 (原始值/10 = 摄氏度)
    val tempTier: Int = 0,
    val socTier: Int = 0,
    val finalTier: Int = 0,
    val state: Int = 0,              // 限流状态
    val maxstate: Int = 16,          // 最大限流状态
    val powerDw: Long = 0,           // 功率 (dW, /10 = W)
    val ts: Long = 0                 // 时间戳
)
```

**派生属性:**
- `tempC: Float = temp / 10f` -- 摄氏度
- `powerW: Float = powerDw / 10f` -- 瓦特
- `statePercent: Float = state / maxstate` -- 限流百分比

**解析来源:** `ChargeStatus.parse(json)` 从 `ModuleConfig.STATUS_JSON` (`/data/adb/modules/hyperos_charge_optimization/webroot/status.json`) 读取。JSON 字段为: `charging`, `mode`, `soc`, `temp`, `temp_tier`, `soc_tier`, `final_tier`, `state`, `maxstate`, `power_dw`, `ts`。

#### 3.2 采集服务: `D:\HyperOSChargeOptimizer\app\src\main\kotlin\com\pvpwhgame\hyperoscharge\service\ChargeMonitorService.kt`

| 协程 | 间隔 | 读取文件 | 输出Flow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 实时状态 | 2秒 | `status.json` | `statusFlow` |
| 历史数据 | 5秒 | `history.csv` | `historyFlow` |
| 学习数据+描述 | 10秒 | 四个 `learn.conf` + `index.html` | `learnDataFlow`, `modeDescsFlow` |

关键代码 - 实时状态更新:
```kotlin
val json = ShellExecutor.readFile(ModuleConfig.STATUS_JSON)
if (json != null) {
    val status = ChargeStatus.parse(json)
    statusFlow.value = status
    updateNotification(status)  // 更新前台通知
}
```

#### 3.3 UI 展示: `D:\HyperOSChargeOptimizer\app\src\main\kotlin\com\pvpwhgame\hyperoscharge\ui\StatusCard.kt`

#### 3.4 充电统计: `D:\HyperOSChargeOptimizer\app\src\main\kotlin\com\pvpwhgame\hyperoscharge\MainActivity.kt`

`ChargeStatsCard` 函数 (第133-182行) 对历史数据做统计:
- **过滤条件:** `history.filter { it.charging == 1 }` -- 只统计正在充电的数据点
- 计算充电时长: `(last.ts - first.ts)` 转换为人性化格式
- 计算电量变化: `last.soc - first.soc`
- 计算充入能量 (Wh): 对相邻数据点用梯形积分:

  ```kotlin
  val avgW = (chPoints[i].powerW + chPoints[i - 1].powerW) / 2.0
  ```

#### 4.3 数据模型解析

**HistoryPoint (CSV解析):** `D:\HyperOSChargeOptimizer\app\src\main\kotlin\com\pvpwhgame\hyperoscharge\data\ChargeHistory.kt`

CSV 格式: `ts,charging,soc,temp,state,maxstate,mode,powerDw`

```kotlin
fun parseCsv(text: String): List<HistoryPoint> {
    return text.trim().split("\n")
        .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        .mapNotNull { line ->
            val parts = line.split(",")
            if (parts.size >= 7) HistoryPoint(
                ts = parts[0].toLongOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null,
                charging = parts[1].toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                soc = parts[2].toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                temp = parts[3].toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                state = parts[4].toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                maxstate = parts[5].toIntOrNull() ?: 16,
                mode = parts[6],
                powerDw = parts.getOrNull(7)?.toLongOrNull() ?: 0
            ) else null
        }
}
```

**LearnData (key=value 解析):** `D:\HyperOSChargeOptimizer\app\src\main\kotlin\com\pvpwhgame\hyperoscharge\data\LearnData.kt`

解析格式示例:
```
LEARNED_STATE=12
LEARNED_POWER_DW=650
LEARNED_DUR=1800
SESSION_COUNT=5
LEARNED_MAX_POWER_DW=1200
```

解析为5个字段:
- `learnedState` -- 学习到的稳定档位 (0-16)
- `learnedPowerDw` -- 稳定功率 (分瓦)
- `learnedDur` -- 稳定时长 (秒)
- `sessionCount` -- 学习会话次数
- `maxPowerDw` -- 最大功率

#### 4.5 充电模式控制

模式写回通过 `ShellExecutor.writeFile(MODE_FILE, mode.key)` 将选中的模式键 (如 `"balance"`, `"fast"`, `"fast_cooler"`, `"cool"`) 写入 `/data/adb/modules/hyperos_charge_optimization/charge_mode`。模块侧读取此文件并切换充电策略。
